trusted_principal_contract: Authenticate every inbound Streamable HTTP request in trusted middleware and store Principal in that HTTP request's extensions. On exact rmcp-v3.1.4 legacy cross-instance restore, the current request Parts are propagated into synthetic initialize/initialized replay; handler identity may therefore be recovered through RequestContext.extensions -> http::request::Parts -> Parts.extensions. Fail closed if Principal is absent; never treat client _meta as identity authority. This is an exact inspected-path claim, not a compiled middleware proof.
